known.title: Not done: A Not done that quotes any one sentence of the fix's Done-when blocks close

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - acceptance criteria describe quoted command output. For example, `The error says "Try again." The command exits with status 1.` contains two sentences, but this regex recognizes neither boundary because the period precedes a closing quote. A finding quoting either sentence therefore receives the follow-up reason at review.py:1016-1017, and `score.holds` returns false for follow-ups, allowing close to proceed. Sentence-ending Markdown markers have the same problem. The added tests cover only punctuation immediately followed by whitespace, leaving this promised case broken.

why: A Not done finding that quotes one sentence of a fix's longer Done-when is treated as naming no owner-approved Done-when item, so it does not block and close prints a wrong reason; and close says the review is clean while listing such findings without saying why each one does not block
